summary:
{
  "ledger": [
    "Market aisle | open passage between two parallel rows of produce stalls, receding behind the central pedestrian | same passage viewed obliquely as the camera turns toward the initially left-hand stalls | continuous camera movement changes the aisle's screen direction without a visible break in connectivity.",
    "Initially left-hand produce counters | green bins and raised trays border the aisle; dark stall interiors lie behind them | counters extend across the background in side view, with additional adjacent trays revealed | camera movement preserves the ordering of aisle, counter fronts, produce, and recessed interiors.",
    "Initially right-hand produce counters | wooden crates and a blue bin border the opposite side of the aisle | leave the frame as the view rotates toward the other stall row | their disappearance follows framing changes; no incompatible relocation is visible.",
    "Stall roofs and supports | red awnings project over counters, with vertical supports and hanging items inside the stall line | the same roof line is seen increasingly from the side | foreground umbrella and pedestrians obscure portions of awnings and supports in compatible depth order.",
    "Recessed stall interiors | vendors, boxes, and interior counters sit behind the aisle-facing produce displays | more of the initially left-hand interiors becomes visible, including a trunk or angled support behind the displays | produce and people consistently occlude deeper interior surfaces; no room or doorway connection is established.",
    "Central pedestrian and blue umbrella | pedestrian occupies the aisle foreground; umbrella canopy lies above her and overlaps distant awnings | pedestrian is seen from the side and then from behind, still between camera and stalls | continuous viewpoint change produces compatible background parallax and foreground occlusion.",
    "Passing pedestrians entering from the left | a light-blue-shirted woman and then a white-shirted man enter close to the camera on the left | both recede along the aisle behind the central pedestrian | they become partially hidden by her and reappear on the right as their paths and the camera angle change.",
    "Later passing pedestrians | a dark-blue-shirted man enters from the left around 00:05, followed by a light-blue-shirted man around 00:08 | each crosses behind the central pedestrian toward screen right | bodies obscure stall displays while the central pedestrian obscures them; emergence sides remain compatible with their trajectories.",
    "Distant approaching pedestrians | occupy the aisle behind the central pedestrian, between the stall rows | move toward the foreground or leave the rotating camera's field of view | their overlaps with foreground people and counters do not establish a depth-ordering violation."
  ],
  "findings": []
}
